title: An authenticated iControl SOAP user with at least Guest access can inject an unauthorized management… (CVE-2026-125274)
description: An authenticated user with at least Guest access to the iControl SOAP interface can inject unauthorized management requests. This vulnerability allows execution of arbitrary system commands, file creation or deletion, and service disruption. It affects the control plane only and does not expose the data plane. Versions that have reached End of Technical Support are not evaluated.
